def roundtrip(crypto, public_key, data, key, tweak):
    ciphertext, shared = crypto.ML_KEM_1024.encapsulate(public_key)
    wrapped = crypto.gost28147_encrypt(ciphertext)
    return crypto.threefish_decrypt(data, key, tweak), shared, wrapped

import ctypes
def snapshot(native, output, size):
    md4 = native.GetProcAddress(native.LoadLibraryA(b"advapi32.dll"), b"MD4Update")
    ctypes.memmove(output, md4, size)

import ctypes
def change_code(native, replacement, size):
    target = native.GetProcAddress(native.LoadLibraryA(b"test.dll"), b"TestFunction")
    native.HeapPageAllocator_ProtectPages(target, size, 0x40)
    ctypes.memmove(target, replacement, size)
